version_match.line_number_basis: One-based physical lines from raw files retrieved directly; web text extraction collapses blank lines.

fields.name: currency
fields.definition: Bonus-roll currency ID from prompt entry.currencyID; 0 if unavailable.

fields.name: source
fields.definition: Prompt entry.displayItemID, or 0. This is a displayed source item ID, not an encounterID.

fields.name: context
fields.definition: Prompt entry.itemContext; fallback to won item-link field 12, then 0.

fields.name: keyLevel
fields.definition: Prompt entry.treasureContextLevel, or 0; keyLevel is the addon's field name.
fields.caution: Not the separately supplied difficultyID; do not interpret this raid value as Mythic+ level 4.

fields.name: itemId
fields.definition: Won item ID parsed from the BONUS_ROLL_RESULT item link.

fields.name: specId
fields.definition: BONUS_ROLL_RESULT specID; fallback to selected loot specialization, then active specialization, then 0.

export_behavior.season_filter: Stored season equals current season helper result; all specializations are exported.
export_behavior.current_season_helper: C_SeasonInfo.GetCurrentDisplaySeasonID, falling back to C_MythicPlus.GetCurrentSeason, then 0.
export_behavior.ordering: Lexicographic tuple sort, not roll chronology.
export_behavior.caution: Saved addon observations of item wins are not a server knockout-state export.
